meta.name: FAQ List (Simple)
meta.description: Simple, static FAQ section with question-answer pairs in vertical stack format

structure.container: lcms-stack with gap-16 for spacing between Q&A pairs
structure.item: lcms-stack with gap-8 for question + answer pairing
structure.question: h4 or strong tag for emphasis

html_structure:
{{QUESTION}}

{{ANSWER}}

QUESTION.description: Question text (start with Who/What/When/Where/Why/How or Is/Can/Do)

ANSWER.description: Answer text (1-3 sentences, concise and helpful)

item_count.note: More than 12 FAQs should be split into categories or use accordion

question_format.style: Natural language questions users would ask
examples: How long does biodegradable packaging take to decompose?
Can sustainable packaging protect products as well?
What is the minimum order quantity?

heading.use: h4 for questions (maintains hierarchy after section h2/h3)

seo_benefits.static_content: All content visible to search engines (unlike accordions)
seo_benefits.schema_markup: Easy to add FAQPage schema for rich results
seo_benefits.readability: Clear, scannable format for users and bots

ai_generation_instructions.when_to_use: User mentions FAQ, questions, common concerns, or support content

content_generation.questions: Anticipate actual user questions based on page content
content_generation.answers: Provide helpful, honest answers that build trust

ai_generation_instructions.quantity: Generate 5-7 FAQs by default, adjust based on page complexity
ai_generation_instructions.tone: Professional but friendly, address user directly

enhancement_options.future_phase_2: Can be enhanced to accordion with JavaScript
enhancement_options.schema_markup: Add FAQPage structured data for SEO
enhancement_options.links: Include inline links to related content
enhancement_options.categories: Group FAQs by topic for long lists

notes: Simple static list is intentionally chosen over accordion for SEO benefits and accessibility. Enhancement to accordion can be done in Phase 2 workflow.
